# Japan Travel by NAVITIME

> > Comprehensive Japan travel platform offering transit search, route planning, itinerary building, and destination guides for exploring Japan's cities, landmarks, and transportation networks.

NAVITIME's Japan Travel service provides travelers with essential tools for navigating Japan's complex transportation system, including support for JR passes, subway tickets, and detailed routing between major destinations like Tokyo, Kyoto, and Mount Fuji. The platform combines real-time transit information with travel guides and booking capabilities to help visitors plan complete journeys across Japan.

## Key Topics

- NAVITIME transit search engine
- Japan Rail Pass (JR Pass)
- Tokyo and Kyoto travel
- Mount Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi access
- Shinkansen (bullet train) routes
- Narita Airport connections
- Tokyo Subway Ticket
- JR Kyushu Rail Pass
- Route planning and itinerary tools
- Railway pass comparison
- Train and bus navigation
- Tourist destination guides
- Transportation booking platform
- Fuji Excursion limited express

## Platform Overview

- [Japan Travel by NAVITIME - Japan Travel Guides, Transit Search and Itinerary Planner](https://japantravel.navitime.com/en/): Homepage for NAVITIME's Japan travel platform with guides and trip planning

## Route Planning & Transit Search

- [Japan Route Finder & Planner](https://japantravel.navitime.com/en/area/jp/route/): Route planner for Japan transit including trains, buses, and rail passes
